title: Witch's Mossy Bookshop
description: A young witch with curly hair stands in the doorway of a wooden treehouse shop nestled in an ancient forest at night. The shop is adorned with hanging lanterns, scrolls, potion bottles, bookshelves, and a sign reading 'MOSS & MANTLE - SPELLS & SUNDRIES', surrounded by ferns, glowing mushrooms, and twisted branches.
prompt: A young female witch with long curly brown hair wearing a blue coat stands inside the open doorway of a magical wooden shop built into a massive ancient tree at night. The shop has bookshelves filled with potions, spellbooks, and jars. A wooden sign reads 'MOSS & MANTLE - SPELLS & SUNDRIES'. Hanging paper scrolls, glowing lanterns, and twisted branches surround the structure. The forest floor is covered in ferns and glowing white mushrooms. Dark blue and teal fantasy atmosphere with soft lantern light.
